ei.title: Human Desire for Eating vs Animals
ei.subject: 6월_2020 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Human Desire for Eating vs Animals

fullPassage: When we compare human and animal desire we find many extraordinary differences. Animals tend to eat with their stomachs, and humans with their brains. When animals' stomachs are full, they stop eating, but humans are never sure when to stop. When they have eaten as much as their bellies can take, they still feel empty, they still feel an urge for further gratification. This is largely due to anxiety, to the knowledge that a constant supply of food is uncertain. Therefore, they eat as much as possible while they can. It is due, also, to the knowledge that, in an insecure world, pleasure is uncertain. Therefore, the immediate pleasure of eating must be exploited to the full, even though it does violence to the digestion.

questions.passage: When we compare human and animal desire we find many (A)[extraordinary / ordinary] differences. Animals tend to eat with their stomachs, and humans with their brains. When animals' stomachs are full, they stop eating, but humans are never sure when to stop. When they have eaten as much as their bellies can take, they still feel empty, they still feel an urge for further gratification. This is largely due to anxiety, to the knowledge that a (B)[temporary / constant] supply of food is uncertain. Therefore, they eat as much as possible while they can. It is due, also, to the knowledge that, in an insecure world, pleasure is uncertain. Therefore, the immediate pleasure of eating must be (C)[wasted / exploited] to the full, even though it does violence to the digestion.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

✅ ① extraordinary(비범한) — constant(지속적인) — exploited(이용된): 원문과 일치하는 올바른 조합 ←정답
❌ ② ordinary(평범한) — constant(지속적인) — exploited(이용된): ordinary는 '평범한'이라는 뜻으로 extraordinary(비범한)의 반의어
❌ ③ extraordinary(비범한) — temporary(일시적인) — exploited(이용된): temporary는 '일시적인'이라는 뜻으로 constant(지속적인)의 반의어
❌ ④ extraordinary(비범한) — constant(지속적인) — wasted(낭비된): wasted는 '낭비된'이라는 뜻으로 exploited(이용된)와 다른 의미
det.tip: extraordinary differences / constant supply / exploited to the full
